name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-02-12, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
